core_philosophy: Botanical Finance. Bringing warmth, trust, and calm to a typically sterile, high-anxiety domain. Mixes old-money elegance (serif fonts) with modern AI precision (mono-spaced data).

rules: Headings must use Playfair Display for an elegant, established 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic.
All tabular data, ledger entries, amounts, and code blocks must use IBM Plex Mono to align decimals and look highly technical.
Never use Inter or generic sans-serif for headings.

marketing_pages.rules: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Embrace asymmetry. Never perfectly fill the grid. Use empty spans for breathing room.

dashboard_pages.rules: High density, flat cardless rectangles, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Strict hierarchy. Use sharp edges or max 8px radius.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A362D] text-white hover:bg-[#2A463D] transition-colors duration-200 rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1A362D] text-[#1A362D] hover:bg-[#F2EBE5] transition-colors duration-200 rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-medium

cards.marketing: No Shadcn cards. Raw div, pure Tailwind, bg-white or bg-[#F2EBE5], rounded-none or rounded-sm, p-8 or p-12, subtle ambient shadow.
cards.dashboard: Flat background, 1px solid subtle border (#1A362D opacity 10%), no shadow. On hover, translate-y-[-2px] with subtle shadow.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism for marketing (Crystal Glass: bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#1A362D]/10). Solid for dashboard.

forms.style: Shadcn components heavily customized. Use IBM Plex Mono for input values (like amounts). Borders must match our 'subtle' border color. Focus rings in #8E9E82.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons must explicitly change bg and text color. Links must have an underline animation or color shift.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus states have contrast. Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations.

testing_requirements.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='ledger-balance-amount').

media_and_assets.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for marketing, Regular/Bold for dashboards)

hero_background.description: Minimalist modern adobe architecture with a clear blue sky, used as an earthy, grounding hero background with a light overlay.

abstract_art_1.description: Fluid art with sage green and white patterns, resembling organic textures. Great for feature section backgrounds.

workspace_lifestyle.description: Cozy coffee mug, notebook, and pencil on a clean minimalist desk. Represents calm productivity.

testimonial_portrait_1.description: Professional business owner portrait for testimonials.

testimonial_portrait_2.description: Businessman sitting confidently on a leather couch, for high-end client testimonials.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use custom layout and Shadcn primitives.
Strictly follow the color palette provided.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings; implement Playfair Display via Google Fonts and map it to Tailwind.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements across the app.
Never use placeholder URLs; rely strictly on the images provided in this JSON.
Design the dashboard for data density, using sharp grid structures and borders.
